stories.title: Nigerian military plane crash kills 32, prompting a three-day national mourning
stories.reason: President Tinubu ordered flags flown at half-mast and a full Air Force investigation after the ATR-42, flying a routine route from Benin City to Lagos, crashed in Ondo state with no survivors among its 25 passengers and seven crew.

stories.title: Yemen's government launches a major offensive to retake all Houthi-held territory
stories.reason: President al-Alimi vowed to fight 'until the country is liberated' after Houthi missile and drone strikes on Riyadh-area oil facilities, with a 100-jet Saudi-led coalition air campaign backing government forces that claim to have retaken the Red Sea towns of Mocha and Dhubab.

stories.title: Germany's intelligence chief warns the country risks a 'violent conflict' with Russia
stories.reason: Martin Jaeger told lawmakers Russia is waging a 'shadow war' with a real and imminent threat of attacks on German soil, prompting Chancellor Merz to say Germany is preparing to respond 'swiftly and very clearly' to hybrid attacks like August's drone incident at Leipzig airport.

stories.title: FBI arrests a California realtor accused of spying on Taiwan's president's son for China
stories.reason: Wanying Zhang was detained at LAX before a flight to China, accused of traveling to Seattle at Beijing's direction to photograph and track President Lai Ching-te's son and his family, a case highlighting Chinese intelligence operations on US soil.

stories.title: Zelensky says Ukraine believes Russia has shared jet-drone technology with North Korea
stories.reason: The alleged exchange, reportedly in return for North Korean missile support, would help explain Russia's sharply increased use of 600 km/h jet-powered drones against Ukrainian cities, which Kyiv currently has no effective way to intercept besides crewed aircraft.

stories.title: Japan's parliament opens with PM Takaichi pushing a food consumption tax cut from 8% to 1%
stories.reason: Takaichi is trying to reassure markets she'll respond 'flexibly' on fiscal policy even as she pushes the two-year tax cut and other inflation relief measures that opposition parties are resisting over concerns about how they'll be funded.

stories.title: Anthropic is reportedly eyeing a mid-November Nasdaq listing at up to a $2 trillion valuation
stories.reason: Marketing for the offering could begin the week of November 9 with proceeds of up to $100 billion, a deal that would rank among the largest IPOs on record, though people familiar with the matter caution the timeline isn't finalized.

stories.title: Germany's Aleph Alpha releases Kolibri, a sovereign open-weight AI model with a 1-million-token context window
stories.reason: Trained from scratch in Germany and Finland on nearly 24 trillion tokens, the 78-billion-parameter bilingual model is freely licensed under Apache 2.0, positioning it as a European alternative to US and Chinese labs in the race for 'sovereign' AI infrastructure.
